svg.text: Orthographic plates, to scale · bow toward top of plate · radiators stowed · Iskar, flagship of the Ninth Expeditionary Fleet, after the Master Specification, Rev 160
dorsal face, port to the left
keel to the left, dorsal to the right
ventral face, port to the right
the collars step down to the cap
squared frame around five drives in an X
her complement at the same scale
keel doors: service bay, heavy berth
dorsal trench, point defense on its lips
